compatibility_rules.acceptance_rule: Every required deliverable carries at least one acceptance condition whose ingredient admits the case regime and situation.
compatibility_rules.activity_rule: Every prerequisite token of the activity of the form needs_form:X must be met by a concrete input of form X, by an inbound relationship transferring form X, or by a recorded assumption; every needs_capacity:K token must be met by a declared resource pool of kind K carrying an allocation for that part.
compatibility_rules.beneficiary_rule: The beneficiary's `scale_band` must appear in the need's `beneficiary_bands`.
compatibility_rules.domain_preference_rule: On these axes the primary domain is a sampling preference only; a case records `domain_matched_axes` so that the mix can be measured rather than assumed.
compatibility_rules.domain_rule: The case's primary_domain must appear in the `domains` of the root need and of every product ingredient used as a component, because those two axes are what the domain classification actually classifies.
compatibility_rules.note: These rules are what generate.py samples from and what checker.py re-derives. An ingredient's `domains` list records the domains in which it is characteristic; its `regimes` and `situations` lists record where it is admissible at all.
compatibility_rules.regime_rule: The regime of the part using an ingredient must appear in that ingredient's `regimes`.
compatibility_rules.situation_rule: At least one of the case's situation tags must appear in the ingredient's `situations`.

CT-ACCEPTANCE_COVER.text: Every required deliverable carries at least one acceptance condition.

CT-ACYCLIC.text: Directed dependency relationships form no cycle; revision cycles are permitted only through RK-FEEDBACK with a bound.

CT-AUTHORITY_SCOPED.text: Any delegated authority carries a named scope and an expiry day within the case window.

CT-CAPACITY_BOUND.text: Total draw on shared pool {pool_id} ({resource}) across all parts must not exceed {capacity} {unit}.

CT-DEPTH_BOUND.text: Composition depth must not exceed {max_depth}, so recursive construction terminates.

CT-DIMENSION_MATCH.text: A quantity transferred between two parts must be expressed in the dimension the receiving part expects.

CT-GENERATOR_EMITS.text: A generator part must be paired with at least one concrete emitted product by an RK-EMIT relationship.

CT-HYPOTHETICAL_LABELLED.text: Every synthetic fixture is labelled hypothetical and is never presented as an observed record.

CT-IDENTITY_UNIQUE.text: Each entity identifier in this case denotes exactly one entity of one declared type.

CT-JUDGMENT_RECORDED.text: Each judgment call is recorded with the criteria applied and the person who applied them.

CT-LANGUAGE_PARITY.text: Where several working languages apply, every language version carries the same obligations.

CT-PII_MINIMISED.text: Personal identifiers are excluded from any published artefact of this case.

CT-PREREQ_CLOSED.text: Every prerequisite declared by a part is met by a concrete input, an inbound relationship, or a recorded assumption.

CT-REGIME_ADMISSIBLE.text: Every ingredient used must declare the regime of the part that uses it.

CT-REVERSIBILITY_DECLARED.text: Each irreversible step names the compensating action available after it, or states that none exists.

CT-SAFETY_INTERLOCK.text: The unsafe action is made impossible by construction rather than discouraged by instruction.

CT-SCHEDULE_FEASIBLE.text: Every part must finish by day {deadline_day} given its duration and the precedences declared.

CT-SITUATION_ADMISSIBLE.text: Every ingredient used must declare at least one of the case's situation tags.

CT-STALENESS_BOUND.text: Repeated exchanges declare a staleness bound and the rendering used once it is exceeded.

CT-UNIT_DECLARED.text: Every transferred quantity carries a unit drawn from the dictionary unit table.

CT-VERSION_STAMPED.text: Outputs derived from versioned rules carry the version of the rules that produced them.

requirement_templates.RT-AUTHORITY: {part} shall act only within the authority declared by {authority} and shall stop at its expiry.

requirement_templates.RT-COMPENSATE: Where {part} performs an irreversible step, it shall name the compensating action or state that none exists.
requirement_templates.RT-DEADLINE: {part} shall be complete by day {day} of the case window.
requirement_templates.RT-DEGRADE: On loss of {what}, {part} shall enter the declared safe state rather than continue on stale values.
requirement_templates.RT-EMIT-CONCRETE: {part} shall emit at least one concrete product, not only a description of what it could emit.
requirement_templates.RT-FIXTURE-LABEL: {part} shall label every synthetic fixture as hypothetical wherever it is displayed.
requirement_templates.RT-IDENTITY-STABLE: {part} shall refer to {entity} by the identifier minted for it and by no other.
requirement_templates.RT-INHERIT: {part} shall preserve the acceptance conditions of the product embedded within it.
requirement_templates.RT-INPUT-PRESENT: {part} shall not begin before {what} is present in the stated form and quantity.
requirement_templates.RT-JOINT-OUTCOME: {part} shall contribute the named share of the joint outcome {outcome}.
requirement_templates.RT-JUDGMENT: {part} shall record who made each judgment call and against which written criterion.
requirement_templates.RT-LIMIT-RESPECT: {part} shall stay within the limit of {amount} {unit} published by {source} and shall declare its behaviour at the limit.
requirement_templates.RT-METHOD-CITED: Every value {part} reports shall cite the method and version that produced it.
requirement_templates.RT-PRIVACY: {part} shall not publish an identifier that resolves to a named individual.
requirement_templates.RT-RECORD-DISAGREEMENT: Where parties disagree, {part} shall retain both accounts rather than resolve them silently.
requirement_templates.RT-RESUME: {part} shall resume from its partial state without discarding completed work.
requirement_templates.RT-REVOCATION: {part} shall cease using {what} within the stated interval after the authorisation is withdrawn.
requirement_templates.RT-STALENESS: {part} shall render the age of {what} and mark it stale beyond {bound} {unit}.
requirement_templates.RT-TRACE: Every figure {part} publishes shall be traceable to the source record it came from.

situations.S-PEAK: Demand or contention at its seasonal or daily peak.
situations.S-PRIVACY-SENSITIVE: Disclosure could harm an identifiable person.
situations.S-PUBLIC-FACING: Members of the public encounter the result directly.
situations.S-REMOTE: Work happens far from support, often without connectivity.
situations.S-ROUTINE: Steady routine operation with known inputs.
situations.S-SAFETY-CRITICAL: A foreseeable failure injures people or destroys value.
situations.S-SCARCITY: A resource needed by several parts is genuinely short.
situations.S-SEASONAL: A short window governs when the work is possible at all.
situations.S-SOLO: One person or household acts alone, without an organisation.
situations.S-STARTUP: A new arrangement with no operating history to learn from.
situations.S-TIME-BOUNDED: A bounded response time decides whether the result is useful at all.
situations.S-UNCERTAIN-EVIDENCE: The evidence is noisy, missing, contested or assumed.
situations.S-VERSION-CHANGE: A definition, schema or rule changes on a schedule.
